---
name: phase-exit
description: Prepare an evidence-based exit record for one ZeroTrace roadmap phase.
---
Use `zerotrace-development-loop`. Read the phase row in `docs/PHASE_GATES.md`, task records and actual test/CI evidence. Do not run external scans or production actions. For every criterion, mark PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED and cite command/output/link or identify missing evidence. Create/update `tasks/evidence/phase-NN.md` from `templates/PHASE_EXIT.md` without self-approving. Report unresolved risks and request human signoff. Do not advance phase.
